name: Interpreters and translators
oneLiner: Ranked the single most AI-affected occupation in Microsoft's usage data.
why: Long-form text translation is a solved problem for current models
The work product is text, and text is what the machine produces

claims.text: Interpreters and translators rank first on Microsoft's list of occupations most affected by generative AI, based on 200,000 real AI conversations.
The ILO finds translations among the occupations that increased in exposure as model capability widened.
